
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- DURATION ERROR -- main.volt:3[/red bold]

`every` interval must be greater than zero — a zero-duration every block would spin without yielding.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware { pin led: Output = 4 }
 [dim]3 |[/dim] every 0ms { led.toggle() }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]      ^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Use a real interval like `every 1ms` for the fastest meaningful rate.[/cyan]
